name: AI Captcha Solver Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  extract_text:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install Python AI Libraries
        run: |
          pip install ddddocr Pillow

      - name: Run AI Captcha Solver
        run: |
          cd "Captcha Solve"
          python main.py
